description: This Java source file defines the class RegistrationClientImpl, which is a client implementation for interacting with Hono's Device Registration API via AMQP protocol, utilizing Vert.x and Proton. It contains methods for creating registration requests, asserting device registration, handling responses, and managing AMQP links and caching.

classes.name: RegistrationClientImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client class for Hono's Registration API, implementing registration and assertion operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new registration client for a tenant, optionally with caching, setting up AMQP links.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Performs an assertion (registration check or update) for a specific device (and optionally a gateway).
